limitations: Diagnostics compare instrumented complete native calls, not isolated kernels or uninstrumented release speed.
Per-cell intervals do not provide simultaneous coverage across all24 comparisons.
Six different reserved Linux hosts are six analysis units, not proof of stochastic independence.
Mac12 mirrored blocks share one active desktop; ordinary OS noise remains.
Repeated-cells and wide-rhs finish before iteration16 in these fixtures, so they do not measure CMG setup or RHS amortization.
Weak-low historical path refuses the removed construction-work cap; its gains combine cap removal and implementation changes.
The separate setup profile has only two recorded observations per cell after one warmup; it targets stages and cannot establish a speed claim.

Executed profile helper bound plugin/patch hashes and exact scientific fingerprints but did not itself enforce all plan/module/baseline bindings or drift. Retained bindings are independently checked; this is narrower assurance than the main diagnostic.

Linux phase attribution used a separate reserved scc-wo4 host; no direct speed comparison to the six primary timing hosts or Mac follows. Sequential W1/W4/W8 phase order and only two recorded observations limit worker-scaling attribution.
